combo.description: To burst down opponents Q then E your target and AA once in melee range. R instantly and AA W once you land.
Catch opponents off guard by using Q then E your target and instantly Flash eAA once in range. Quickly W R and then AA when you land.
Use E on your target then instantly W Q and AA during the stun to partially cancel the animation of W.
You can hide your E animation when used this way. Q then AA and then quickly E W and AA after.
To gank and maximize crowd control E your target, R on top of them and quickly AA Q then AA W.
Gank before level 6 using E on your target, then instantly Q. Run into melee range AA then AA W.
For more damage use Q then E your target once in range. AA once you are in melee range then quickly W followed by AA R.
After level 6 use your ultimate to engage. Q and E instantly then R to get into range and quickly AA W.
When someone face checks you E then instantly AA W your target. Follow with AA Q AA as quickly as you can.
